actions.action: Preserve product focus with a predictable fallback
actions.mechanism: Track product and control identity across reordering; disappearing products send focus to the persistent results heading.
actions.implementation: Key cards by product ID. Preserve the active control when retained. If removed while focused, focus the heading using tabindex="-1"; otherwise never move focus.
actions.check: Keyboard-test retained-item reordering and focused-item removal. Confirm the same control remains active or the heading receives focus; verify screen-reader output.
actions.risk: Index-based keys or unconditional focus restoration can redirect users unexpectedly.

actions.action: Separate immediate counts from result rendering
actions.mechanism: A persistent status distinguishes pending, completed, empty, and failed requests without waiting for all cards to render.
actions.implementation: Show “Updating” during requests; label any previous count. Reject stale responses. Publish accepted totals immediately in visible text and a polite status outside the busy results container.
actions.check: Measure count publication within one second of arrival. Test zero, failure, and reversed response order; verify loading never announces zero.
actions.risk: Screen-reader speech may queue even when the count is available.

actions.action: Offer a compact view without reducing coverage
actions.mechanism: A text-first view reduces scanning detail while preserving every matching product and access to full information.
actions.implementation: Add keyboard-operable Grid/Compact buttons. Compact mode shows product names, prices, distinguishing variants, and detail links. Share result data and ordering; keep focus on the activated view button.
actions.check: For 200 matches, compare product IDs across views: none missing. Keyboard-open details and verify view switching preserves filter state and count.
actions.risk: Over-simplification can hide distinctions; retain variant labels rather than merging products.
